meta.auditSource: 宝宝早教资源库-正式实施交接包/02-资源审计与实施规划.md

ageScope.zh: 本资源库面向 0～3 岁家庭，不细分更小年龄段。是否适合当前孩子，请家长结合实际发展情况陪同选择。
ageScope.en: This library is for families with children aged 0–3 and does not use narrower age brackets. Parents should decide what suits each child and supervise play.

evidenceNotice.zh: 条目来自公开资料与单个家庭的真实反馈。页面标注的是证据状态，不是对所有孩子适用性的保证。
evidenceNotice.en: Entries reflect public information and one family’s real experience. Labels describe evidence, not a guarantee that every child will enjoy or benefit from a resource.

illustrationNotice.zh: 站内插画为本站原创的通用分类示意图，不是游戏官方截图，也不代表授权素材。
illustrationNotice.en: Illustrations are original generic placeholders created for this site. They are not official game artwork or licensed screenshots.

description.zh: 打开第三方官方网页活动。本站不托管内容，声音、广告与浏览器兼容性以实际设备为准。
description.en: Opens the third-party official web activity. This site does not host it; audio, ads and browser compatibility depend on the real device.

description.zh: 打开官方应用商店页面，需要自行安装。本按钮不是网页版游戏入口。
description.en: Opens the official app store page; installation is required. This is not a browser game entry.

description.zh: 打开开源项目源码页。通常需要在本地运行，不是直接在线游玩入口。
description.en: Opens the open-source project page. It usually needs to be run locally and is not a direct online play entry.

description.zh: 打开开发者官方页面，其中可能包含下载或试玩入口，需要自行确认实际可用性。
description.en: Opens the developer’s official page, which may include download or play links. Verify availability yourself.

description.zh: 家长在实际设备上操作并记录了结果。仍属单个家庭体验，不代表普遍适用。
description.en: A parent used it on a real device and recorded the result. This is still one family’s experience, not a general guarantee.

description.zh: 自动化流程看到界面推进，不代表声音、完整玩法或儿童喜爱程度已经验证。
description.en: Automation observed the interface progressing. It does not prove audio, complete gameplay or child engagement.

description.zh: 仅依据开发者页面或项目 README 的说明，本站未独立复核。
description.en: Based only on the developer page or project README; not independently checked by this site.

description.zh: 入口存在，但关键体验（声音、完整流程、安装等）尚未验证。
description.en: The entry exists, but key experience such as audio, complete flow or installation is still unverified.

description.zh: 有加载、声音或其他异常反馈，详情以该条资源的验证记录为准。
description.en: Loading, audio or other issues were reported. See the resource’s verification record for details.

description.zh: 有本家庭明确的正面体验，放在首页前列；个体体验不代表对所有孩子都适用。
description.en: This family reported a clearly positive experience, so it appears near the top. One family’s experience does not apply to every child.

description.zh: 入口与资料存在，关键体验仍有未验证项。
description.en: The entry and materials exist, but key experience remains unverified.

description.zh: 有年龄、音频或兴趣方面的边界，适合家长按需挑选，不进入主推。
description.en: Has age, audio or engagement limits. Suitable for parents to choose selectively, not a priority recommendation.

description.zh: 全部 14 条资源，按精选分层排序。
description.en: All 14 resources, ordered by editorial tier.

description.zh: 家长明确报告孩子喜欢的资源。来自单个家庭体验，不代表普遍适用。
description.en: Resources this family’s child clearly enjoyed. This is one family’s experience, not a general recommendation.

description.zh: 有中文词汇、发音或童谣内容。界面语言与资源实际语言是两回事。
description.en: Includes Chinese vocabulary, speech or songs. Interface language is separate from the resource’s actual language.

description.zh: 有英文歌词或听说内容。当前仅收录 1 条观察库资源，不等同于英语课程。
description.en: Includes English lyrics or listening content. Only one Watch-tier resource currently qualifies; this is not an English course.

description.zh: 以音乐、节奏或身体律动为主。
description.en: Primarily music, rhythm or physical movement.

description.zh: 按键触发图案或声音的玩法，不优先推荐；注意区分可玩网页、官方页面和源码项目。
description.en: Keyboard-triggered visuals or sounds. Not a priority recommendation; distinguish playable web pages, official pages and source projects.

description.zh: 以动物认知或动物角色为主。
description.en: Animal recognition or animal characters.

description.zh: 绘画、颜色、形状或创意操作。
description.en: Drawing, colours, shapes or creative play.

description.zh: 声音、动作与视觉反馈类的感官探索。
description.en: Sensory exploration through sound, movement and visual feedback.

name.zh: Lucas Baby Games · 宝宝互动合集

summary.zh: 音乐、声音、宝宝电话和多种互动内容；家长确认孩子喜欢其中的角色舞蹈。
summary.en: Music, sounds, a baby phone and varied activities; this family’s child enjoys the dancing characters.

note.zh: 商店页面可获取；内购与完整功能范围未核实。
note.en: Available from the store page; in-app purchases and the full feature scope are unverified.

observations.zh: 家长确认本地应用有声音，孩子喜欢其中的角色舞蹈；完整功能范围与内购未重新核实。
observations.en: The parent confirmed local audio works and the child enjoys the dancing characters; the full feature scope and in-app purchases were not rechecked.

parentGuidance.zh: 家长陪同使用，以孩子当下的反应为准；不要把它当作适龄保证。
parentGuidance.en: Use with a parent and follow the child’s response; this is not an age-suitability guarantee.

summary.zh: 动物、水果和日常物品的简单互动；官网提供简体中文，语音取决于系统 TTS。
summary.en: Simple interaction with animals, fruit and everyday objects; Chinese text is available and speech depends on system TTS.

note.zh: 开发者声明免费、无广告。
note.en: The developer states it is free and ad-free.

observations.zh: 官网声明免费、无广告并提供简体中文；语音依赖系统 TTS。家用电脑网页版曾出现无声，普通话发音未实测。
observations.en: The site says it is free, ad-free and offers Chinese text; speech uses system TTS. The family PC’s browser was silent before, and Mandarin pronunciation has not been tested.

issues.zh: 家用电脑网页版曾出现无声
issues.en: Web audio was silent on the family PC

providerClaim.zh: 官网主要面向 18 个月～3 岁（开发者说明）
providerClaim.en: The developer describes the site as mainly for 18 months to 3 years

parentGuidance.zh: 家长陪同，先确认设备语音是否正常；显示简体中文不等于普通话已正常播放。
parentGuidance.en: Use with a parent and check device audio first; Chinese text does not prove Mandarin audio works.

name.zh: Digital Dialects 中文动物卡片

summary.zh: 点击动物卡片查看中文词语和发音；保存的是动物页直接入口。
summary.en: Animal flashcards with Chinese vocabulary and audio; this link points directly to the animals activity.

learningFocus.zh: 中文动物词汇与拼音发音
learningFocus.en: Chinese animal words with pinyin audio

note.zh: 页面出现过广告；免费范围未逐项核对。
note.en: Ads were seen on the page; the free scope was not checked item by item.

observations.zh: 动物页入口存在；官网把普通话拼音音频测试和简体字无声测试分开列出。原总入口曾加载失败，页面出现过广告；简体字与发音组合未实测。
observations.en: The animals entry exists. The site lists a Mandarin pinyin audio test and a silent simplified-character test separately. The original index failed to load, ads appeared, and the combined text-plus-audio experience was not tested.

issues.en: The original index failed to load

issues.zh: 简体字与发音组合未实测
issues.en: Simplified text plus audio was not tested together

parentGuidance.zh: 家长陪同，先试听再决定是否使用；不要把它当作已经验证的普通话课程。
parentGuidance.en: Use with a parent, preview the audio, and do not treat it as a verified Mandarin course.

summary.zh: 点击后看卡通角色跳舞，适合家长陪孩子一起模仿动作。
summary.en: Tap to see cartoon characters dance and copy their moves together.

note.zh: 官方网页可直接打开；是否需要账号或地区限制未核对。
note.en: The official web page opens directly; account or regional restrictions were not checked.

observations.zh: PBS 官方 Play Game 入口存在；家长反馈部分网页活动无声，尚未逐项复核。
observations.en: The official PBS Play Game entry exists; the parent reported silent web activities, and this has not been checked item by item.

parentGuidance.zh: 家长陪同，先确认声音和页面加载，再决定是否继续。
parentGuidance.en: Use with a parent, check audio and page loading first, then decide whether to continue.

summary.zh: 点节拍、听节奏变化；是音乐创作互动，不是角色跳舞。
summary.en: Tap beats and explore rhythm. This is a music-making interaction, not character dancing.

note.zh: 官方网页可直接打开；免费范围未逐项核对。
note.en: The official web page opens directly; the free scope was not checked item by item.

observations.zh: 官方说明可使用 Chrome 等浏览器；执行记录看到节奏控件可运行。家长反馈部分网页无声，浏览器兼容与音频待复核。
observations.en: The official site says Chrome and similar browsers work; automation saw the rhythm controls run. The parent reported silent web activities, so browser compatibility and audio need rechecking.

parentGuidance.zh: 家长陪同；若浏览器提示不兼容，换用 Chrome 再试。
parentGuidance.en: Use with a parent; if the browser reports incompatibility, try Chrome.

summary.zh: 中文童谣和亲子跟唱内容；部分内容面向更大儿童。
summary.en: Mandarin songs and parent-child sing-along content; some material is intended for older children.

note.zh: 官网可打开；免费范围与是否需要账号未核对。
note.en: The site opens; the free scope and whether an account is needed were not checked.

observations.zh: 开发者明确定位 3～8 岁，包含童谣但以识字类内容为主；家长曾遇网页无声。适合家长挑选后陪同。
observations.en: The developer positions it for ages 3–8. It includes songs but focuses on character recognition; the parent encountered silent pages. Suitable only when a parent selects content.

issues.en: The parent encountered a silent page

parentGuidance.zh: 只挑童谣类内容，家长陪同；不进入 0～3 岁主推。
parentGuidance.en: Choose only the song content and use with a parent; not a priority for the 0–3 age range.

summary.zh: 和恐龙一起做舞蹈互动；完整舞蹈流程尚未验证。
summary.en: Dance with dinosaurs; the complete dance flow is still unverified.

note.zh: 官方网页可直接打开；是否需要账号或地区限制未核对。
note.en: The official web page opens directly; account or regional restrictions were not checked.

observations.zh: 官方入口存在；此前只确认页面和角色显示，未走通完整舞蹈流程。
observations.en: The official entry exists; only the page and characters were confirmed, and the complete dance flow was not completed.

parentGuidance.zh: 家长陪同尝试；若页面停滞，可换其他舞蹈类资源。
parentGuidance.en: Try with a parent; if the page stalls, choose another dance resource.

summary.zh: 跟随角色动作和音乐做简单律动，英文内容。
summary.en: Follow simple character movements and music; English content.

note.zh: 官方网页可直接打开；是否需要账号或地区限制未核对。
note.en: The official web page opens directly; account or regional restrictions were not checked.

observations.zh: 此前测试确认角色动画可推进；声音未独立确认。
observations.en: Earlier testing confirmed the character animation advances; audio was not independently confirmed.

parentGuidance.zh: 家长陪同，先确认声音，再跟着角色做动作。
parentGuidance.en: Use with a parent, check audio first, then copy the character’s movements.

summary.zh: 点击花园中的元素，探索动画、声音和节奏。
summary.en: Explore animation, sound and rhythm by tapping elements in a garden.

note.zh: 官方网页可直接打开；是否需要账号或地区限制未核对。
note.en: The official web page opens directly; account or regional restrictions were not checked.

observations.zh: 此前画面和种花操作通过；声音未独立确认。
observations.en: The visuals and planting interaction worked in earlier testing; audio was not independently confirmed.

parentGuidance.zh: 家长陪同，把点击和声音当作探索，不追求完成度。
parentGuidance.en: Use with a parent and treat tapping and sound as exploration, not a task to complete.

summary.zh: 卡通恐龙配合英文歌曲做动作，屏幕显示歌词，适合亲子模仿。
summary.en: A cartoon dinosaur moves to English songs with on-screen lyrics, inviting parents and children to join in.

note.zh: 网页可打开；免费范围与广告情况未核对。
note.en: The page opens; the free scope and advertising were not checked.

observations.zh: 执行记录看到歌词和动画推进；网站标注 3～8 岁，开发者称幼儿可陪玩；家庭网页音频待确认。
observations.en: Automation saw lyrics and animation progress. The site labels it for ages 3–8, while the developer says younger children can join with a parent; home audio is still unconfirmed.

issues.en: The site labels it for ages 3–8

providerClaim.zh: 网站标注 3～8 岁；开发者称幼儿可陪玩
providerClaim.en: The site labels it for ages 3–8; the developer says younger children can join with a parent

parentGuidance.zh: 作为英文儿歌跟唱使用，家长陪同；因官方标称年龄偏大，不进入主推。
parentGuidance.en: Use as English sing-along with a parent; because the official age label is older, it is not a priority recommendation.

summary.zh: 任意按键触发形状和声音；家长表示孩子对这类玩法兴趣一般。
summary.en: Any key press triggers shapes and sounds; this family’s child was not very engaged by this type of play.

note.zh: 开发者站点提供 Windows 下载与 Play now 入口；付费范围未核实。
note.en: The developer site offers a Windows download and Play now entry; the paid scope is unverified.

observations.zh: 家长明确表示这类玩法兴趣一般；官方站点提供 Windows 下载与 Play now 入口。
observations.en: The parent said this type of play was not very engaging; the official site offers a Windows download and a Play now entry.

parentGuidance.zh: 仅在孩子对键盘反馈感兴趣时尝试，不作为首推；页面按钮不是直接在线游玩入口。
parentGuidance.en: Try only if the child enjoys keyboard feedback; not a priority. The page button is not a direct online play entry.

name.zh: Kids Keyboard Smash · 随便敲键盘

summary.zh: 随手敲键触发彩色画面与反馈；仓库提供 index.html 和 Windows 启动脚本。
summary.en: Colourful keyboard-triggered effects; the repository provides index.html and a Windows launch script.

note.zh: 开源仓库，README 声明项目可用；未核对许可证与当前版本。
note.en: Open-source repository; the README describes the project. The licence and current release were not checked.

device.en: Not tested on this round’s devices

observations.zh: GitHub README 给出 index.html 与 Windows 启动脚本；AutoHotkey 属可选辅助依赖。仓库链接不是游戏直达，当前版本、声音和安装方式未重新核实。
observations.en: The GitHub README provides index.html and a Windows launch script; AutoHotkey is an optional helper. The repository is not a direct game link, and the current release, audio and installation were not rechecked.

parentGuidance.zh: 家长按 README 在本地运行；不要把它当成可直接在线玩的网页。
parentGuidance.en: Run it locally following the README; do not treat it as a directly playable web page.

summary.zh: 键盘触发图案和小动画；README 声明单文件 HTML、可离线打开。
summary.en: Keyboard-triggered patterns and small animations; the README says it is a single HTML file that can open offline.

note.zh: README 声明单文件 HTML、可离线打开；许可证与在线演示入口未核对。
note.en: The README says it is a single HTML file that works offline; the licence and online demo entry were not checked.

device.en: Not tested on this round’s devices

observations.zh: README 声明单文件 HTML、可离线直接打开；官网或在线演示直达入口仍需校验。链接指向源码仓库，不保证直接在线游玩。
observations.en: The README says it is a single HTML file that can open offline. A direct official or online demo entry still needs checking. The link points to source code, not a guaranteed online game.

parentGuidance.zh: 可下载后本地打开；在线版是否可用需家长自行确认。
parentGuidance.en: Download and open locally; parents should confirm whether an online version works.

summary.zh: 涂色、颜色和形状互动；属于待评估的 Windows 候选。
summary.en: Colouring, colour and shape activities; a Windows candidate awaiting hands-on review.

note.zh: 商品页存在；免费范围、内购和适龄未核实。
note.en: The store listing exists; the free scope, in-app purchases and age suitability are unverified.

device.en: Not tested on this round’s devices

observations.zh: 仅确认微软商店商品页存在；安装、适龄和实际功能未实测。
observations.en: Only the Microsoft Store listing was confirmed; installation, age suitability and actual features were not tested.

issues.zh: 安装与实际功能未实测

parentGuidance.zh: 家长先查看商店适龄说明，再决定是否安装。
parentGuidance.en: Parents should check the store’s age information before installing.
